name: Runpod
description: Runpod lets agents list and manage pods, serverless endpoints, templates, and network volumes in the account of the signed-in user. Pods and endpoints that an agent creates use account credit.

prompts.text: List my running pods and their GPU types.
Which network volumes do I have, and in which data centers?
Show the templates I have created.

apps.name: Runpod
apps.description: Pods, serverless endpoints, templates, and volumes, over Runpod's MCP server with browser sign-in.
